_comment: Higgsfield 'Soul' text-to-image prompts for the Edition Rent site. 'name' becomes assets/<name>.<ext> (extension is detected from the response). width_and_height options: landscape 2048x1152 / 2048x1536, portrait 1536x2048 / 1152x2048, square 1536x1536. quality: '720p' or '1080p'. See cloud.higgsfield.ai docs. enhance_prompt auto-improves the prompt.
